scope: Four backend v1 consumers, three repeats per condition; no React or v2/v3 model task, universal algorithm or controlled performance claim.
snapshot_scope: Frozen dirty checkout based on aed5b418; routing, generator and runtime API changes captured before later documentation/license additions and Go publication-status bookkeeping. Not the exact final Git tree.
execution_order: Repeat 1 baseline then skill per stack; repeat 2 skill then baseline; repeat 3 baseline then skill. Stack order python, go, java, rust. Sequential model trials.
limitations: n=3 per cell; descriptive statistics only, with no significance test or general model/language ranking.
Requested model ID is passed explicitly; absent trace model IDs remain null. An alias does not guarantee immutable server weights.

Concurrent local v1/browser checks, Maven packaging, crate tests and Go module consumer activity shared host resources; wall-time differences are not controlled performance evidence. Remote GitHub CI used separate hosts.
Compiler, dependency and prompt caches were not isolated; alternating condition order does not remove cache or order effects.
CLI input and cached input are reported observations; cached input is a subset, not an additional token charge. Tokens do not establish billing.
Global/runtime instructions may remain despite ignoring user configuration. Command path references do not prove automatic skill selection or complete reading.
No React model task, PostgreSQL/account/mail model task, production deployment, security audit or universal model algorithm was measured.
The base commit alone cannot reconstruct the exact uncommitted captured input; hashes identify retained local snapshots, not the final Git tree.

go.interpretation: Extra exploratory tests are observed; their causal contribution to input tokens is not measured.

java.interpretation: Reference library packaging and per-app Maven cache work are observable next targets, not a proven explanation of the complete time difference.
